notes: Pros: Services are split into separate files and own their data stores; inter-service communication uses an in-memory EventBus; HTTP handling is confined to the ApiRouter; demo script exercises the flow; no external npm dependencies. Issues: The router’s DELETE endpoints return 204 but never call the services’ delete methods (users/projects/tasks/comments), breaking CRUD completeness. TaskService.update allows arbitrary status changes, bypassing the forward-only transition rule (todo → in-progress → done) and violating the architectural constraint. Router republishes comment.added with a different payload, leading to duplicate event names and inconsistent event schemas; better to standardize event payloads in the service or introduce a dedicated orchestrator pattern. Many endpoints return 200 with null for not-found instead of 404; input validation is minimal; widespread use of any via shims reduces type safety. EventBus is synchronous and error-swallowing; okay but could be improved. Overall, good structure with notable correctness and constraint issues.
